# PRV-IMP-01

**Is the privacy impact assessment, or the data protection impact assessment, handed over and cited as evidence?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Privacy by design](privacy.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | IMP: Impact and risk |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `evidence.type` |

## Why it matters

This lens is the design-facing part of privacy; the impact assessment is a separate assessment with its own owner. The design review checks it has been handed over, and the production entry assessment reads its outcome.

## Rule

The evidence includes at least one item of type privacy-impact-assessment, planned or done.

## Check

The tool applies this rule as written:

```yaml
for_each: evidence
where:
  type: privacy-impact-assessment
count:
  min: 1
message: no privacy impact assessment is cited as evidence
```

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 35, data protection impact assessment. (`gdpr-35`)
- ISO/IEC 29134, Information technology, Security techniques, Guidelines for privacy impact assessment. (`iso-29134`)
